description: A finite clause set closed under resolution and not containing the empty clause is satisfiable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.closed_satisfiable.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  {Γ : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSet α} (h : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Closed Γ) (he : ∅ ∉ Γ) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Sat Γ
